name: actor-21-patent-ip-enforcement-monitor
description: Global Patent & IP Enforcement Actions Monitor: real, adversarial USPTO Patent Trial and Appeal Board (PTAB) proceedings (Inter Partes Review, Post-Grant Review, Covered Business Method, Derivation -- not ordinary patent grants) via the USPTO Open Data Portal, plus an optional EPO Open Patent Services opposition-watch module for a caller-supplied EP publication watchlist. Both require an operator-supplied API credential (BYOK) obtained through each office's own free registration -- no CAPTCHA-solving, fingerprint spoofing, or WAF/OAuth-gate bypass. Legacy PatentsView PatentSearch API and WIPO PATENTSCOPE were live-verified and found unavailable/non-free for v1 -- see src/http.ts.
author: Stefano
